column1: # Hardware-routed host tokens (bit 0 of the token-map entry set) with the command number in bits 15-23.

# (ged_bound_table.tsv), blank if init_ged writes none, and blank for the geometry form (bit 31 set),
# which does not use the handler table (software/ucode/arm1.md). form = geometry, pass (bit 5 clear) or
